title: Start, stop or restart Ollama
description: Runs systemctl for the Ollama service. Stopping or restarting unloads any loaded model.

action.description: What to do with the Ollama service.

steps.title: Tell systemd to change the Ollama service
steps.why: Ollama runs as a system service.
steps.run:
systemctl "$P_action" ollama
systemctl is-active ollama || true
steps.verify: case "$P_action" in stop) ! systemctl is-active --quiet ollama;; *) i=0; while [ $i -lt 20 ]; do systemctl is-active --quiet ollama && exit 0; i=$((i+1)); sleep 1; done; exit 1;; esac
